messages.author: cd1404481f4e2345
messages.subject: Suppressing Warning Messages
parts:
Hi wonderful list,

A very quick question. I'm running a simulation where I call Stan 1000+ times. Convergence isn't an issue, but, as often happens, many of the initial draws yield that familiar warning message: "Informational Message: The parameter state is about to be Metropolis rejected..." etc. 

In this case, it would be convenient to suppress these messages in some way, as they mask otherwise useful output. Is there a simple way to do that? Obviously I can just deal with all of this in post-processing, but figured I'd ask.

Many thanks,
Avi

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Suppressing Warning Messages
parts:
You can get rid of some of it by wrapping your calls to stan() inside a suppressMessages() but that isn't going to eliminate everything.

Ben
